property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, C.transfer always calls the callee once for every element of _tos (so a recording helper sees calls equal to _tos.length); the mutant skips the first element and thus results in fewer calls for some inputs.
change_summary: Invert loop bounds to iterate while i<=_tos.length-1 using a do-while style by changing the for loop to a while loop that starts at i=1, causing different iteration behavior (skips first element) and thus different calls/return value when _tos non-empty.
